What it solves: CORRECTED ROOT CAUSE (the intake assumed pack overrides currently work
and only a bare/no-pack launch is exposed — that assumption is FALSE;
verified against both the code and this live session):
How it works: Launching with a pack that declares a different active_backlog_max_depth makes the real WARNING and AUTO-PROMOTE gates enforce the pack's cap, not the default swarmforge.conf's
